questions.q: In this repository's library code (lib/), find every place where a RequestAbortedError is created. For each one, give the file and the enclosing function or method.
In this repository's library code (lib/), find every place where a HeadersTimeoutError or a BodyTimeoutError is created. For each one, give the file and the enclosing function or method.

In this repository's library code (lib/), find every place outside lib/errors.js that throws or returns one of the content-type-parser errors (the FST_ERR_CTP_* codes). For each one, give the file and the enclosing function.

In this repository's library code (lib/), find every place outside lib/errors.js that throws or returns one of the hook errors (the FST_ERR_HOOK_* codes). For each one, give the file and the enclosing function.
In this library, list every class that defines its own __setitem__ or popitem method. For each, give the file, the class and which of the two methods it defines.
In this library's source code, find every method or function that calls expire(). For each call, give the file and the enclosing class and method.
In this package's source (the markdown/ directory), find every place that registers a tree processor (treeprocessors.register). For each, give the file and the enclosing class and method.

In this package's source (the markdown/ directory), list every class that subclasses an InlineProcessor class (directly, by naming a class ending in InlineProcessor as its base). Give the file and class name for each.
In this library's source code (src/), find every place that raises BrokenResourceError. For each, give the file and the enclosing class and method.
In this library's source code (src/), list every class that implements an aclose() method. Give the file and the class for each.
In zod's v4 core (packages/zod/src/v4/core, excluding tests), find every place that reads the coerce option of a schema definition. For each, give the file and the enclosing function.

In zod's v4 source (packages/zod/src/v4, excluding tests), find every place that throws $ZodAsyncError, the error raised when a Promise shows up during synchronous parsing. For each, give the file and the enclosing function.
